problem: Provide reliable answers about Bittensor fundamentals.

brief.problem: Provide reliable answers about Bittensor fundamentals.
brief.how_validators_check: Compare responses to a fixed labelled dataset; reward correctness and timely responses.
brief.how_rewards_flow: Normalize scores into relative weights using an exponential moving average.
brief.how_cheaters_lose: Timeouts score zero; duplicate answers split credit. Duplicate text alone does not prove cheating.
brief.why_this_design: Deterministic dataset scoring provides a reproducible local demo without model API calls.
brief.alternative_considered: An LLM judge adds flexible evaluation but requires an online model and separate validation.
